interface.label_semantics_evidence: inferred from actual persisted labeled examples; not independent formal ontology validation
interface.input: ASCII lower-case letters, digits, spaces, 8-180 chars, normalized spaces; exactly one evone and evtwo per row
interface.features: bias, indexed unigrams, unigrams, bigrams, trigrams; SHA256 first four bytes little endian modulo 128; unique sorted bins; linear scores normalized by sqrt(active bins)
interface.output: 9-way softmax; argmax first tie; emit label iff max>=0.65 and argmax not label16, otherwise None
interface.scoring: correct only known label!=16 and prediction matches; wrong known non-None mismatches; unknown_false unknown label16 non-None. Correct abstentions not counted as correct by historical scorer.
interface.limitations: No raw JSON parser, arbitrary values, generation, multilabel output, arbitrary causal semantics or general equivalence. Hash collisions possible. Feature-level identifiability not yet measured. Adapter must not leak answer or solve task before classifier; deterministic parser baseline separate.
